author: Hermes
question: A megger is used in the field to measure which quantity?
solution: A megger is a hand- or motor-driven high-voltage ohmmeter used to check insulation resistance of cables, windings and installations. Topic (measurement) is in the Measurements section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Measurements
